parameters.name: SourceRef
parameters.description: Mandatory parameter. Specifies one or multiple sources from where the log messages originate.

parameters.name: FilterRef
parameters.description: The Filter associated with the {{object}} entry. When referencing multiple Filter rules, it is mandatory to execute them in the order listed within the parameter. Example: FilterRef=.Syslog.Filter.3,.Syslog.Filter.1 First filter rule 3 must be executed and then filter rule 1. When no Filter is specified the log message will not be filtered.

parameters.name: TemplateRef
parameters.description: The Template associated with the {{object}} entry. When no Template is specified the log message will not be altered by the template system.

parameters.name: StructuredData
parameters.description: This feature represents the ability to log messages in structured-data format. Reference {{bibref|RFC5424|The Syslog Protocol}}.

object.description: This object describes the log action parameters for syslog.
